_comment: LLMs of the evaluation: names of src/llm.py (LLM_CONFIGS) or provider:model.
_single_llm: our approach with this LLM only (no vote): the comparison with the baselines at the same LLM
_user: simulated user: an LLM of another family than the negotiation LLM (evaluation sheet), every answer logged with the choice expected from the proposal of the solver; or "deterministic" (reads the proposal of the solver)
_reference: strong LLMs alone, with the reference methods only
